'''Benes''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[major]] in the ground forces of the [[Republic First Fleet]] who fought in the [[Battle of Kuat (Galactic War)|Battle of Kuat]] during the [[Galactic War]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] aboard the [[Kuat Defensive Station]].
